pick.headline: Taraki ousted; Hafizullah Amin takes power in Kabul

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Middle East & N. Africa, Vol. V No. 181, 17 September 1979
evidence.snippet: V. 17 Sep 79 “+ MIDDLE EAST & NORTH AFRICA Amin Meets With Soviet Ambassador 15 September Kabul Reports Burial of Taraki Aide, Obituary Rebel Successes Reported in Herat, Konar Provinces AFP: Muslim Courts Order Execution of 32 Marxists Rebel Spokesman Claims No Aid Being Received Kabul Radio Condemns 'Imperialist' Intervention ANNNNN FwW…

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Middle East & Africa, Vol. V No. 181, 17 September 1982
evidence.snippet: …YEDI'OT AHARONOT interveiw that the IDF will not enter encircled Palestinian refugee camps, but called on "terrorists" hiding in them to surrender, Jerusalem radio reported. The IDF will entrust the task of purging the Sabra and Shatila areas to the Phalangists, IDF radio announced. The Phalangists meanwhile killed two men who had violated the recently imposed curfew in southern Lebanon, according to Jerusalem radio.
